purpose: Runs a research funding call from publication through submission, eligibility screening, blind peer review and panel adjudication against a fixed budget envelope, and reports where every proposal stands.

requirements.name: ::Quorum.ResearchFunding.AccessControl.PersonalDataErasable
requirements.text: An account's personal data can be erased on request by an operator: identifiers are pseudonymised everywhere they are held, while business records (proposals, reviews, decisions, budget) are retained under business-record retention.

requirements.name: ::Quorum.ResearchFunding.AccessControl.RoleScopedAuthority
requirements.text: INV-11 — An account may act only in a role it has been granted, and only on resources its role scopes it to. Deny by default.

requirements.name: ::Quorum.ResearchFunding.BlindPeerReview.BlindUntilOwnSubmitted
requirements.text: INV-7 — A reviewer may not read any other review of a proposal until their own review for it is submitted.

requirements.name: ::Quorum.ResearchFunding.BlindPeerReview.CompleteScoring
requirements.text: INV-6 — A review must score every published criterion of its call, each on 1–5, before it may be submitted.

requirements.name: ::Quorum.ResearchFunding.CallAdministration.SubmissionWindow
requirements.text: INV-1 — A proposal may be submitted only while its call is open and strictly before the call's deadline.

requirements.name: ::Quorum.ResearchFunding.EligibilityScreening.AgentNeverDecides
requirements.text: INV-10 — The eligibility triage agent may propose a verdict but may never move a proposal out of screening.

requirements.name: ::Quorum.ResearchFunding.PanelAdjudication.ChairDecidesScoredOnly
requirements.text: INV-8 — Only a PanelChair may record a panel decision, and only for a proposal in scored.

requirements.name: ::Quorum.ResearchFunding.PanelAdjudication.DecisionsEscalated
requirements.text: J7 — A chair decision still pending after 14 days notifies the program officer exactly once; nothing is decided by timeout.

requirements.name: ::Quorum.ResearchFunding.PanelAdjudication.EnvelopeNeverExceeded
requirements.text: INV-9 — The sum of all awarded amounts for a call may never exceed the call's budget envelope.

requirements.name: ::Quorum.ResearchFunding.ParticipantNotification.NotificationsDurable
requirements.text: NFR-5 — Notifications are queued durably and delivered at least once; a failed delivery is visible and retryable.

requirements.name: ::Quorum.ResearchFunding.PortfolioReporting.PortfolioFromProjection
requirements.text: J8 — The portfolio is served from a projection fed by events, never from the write model.

requirements.name: ::Quorum.ResearchFunding.PortfolioReporting.TransitionsAudited
requirements.text: NFR-8 — Every state transition is recorded with actor, timestamp and reason.

requirements.name: ::Quorum.ResearchFunding.ProposalSubmission.SubmitOnce
requirements.text: INV-2 — A proposal is submitted at most once; submission is irreversible except by withdrawal.

requirements.name: ::Quorum.ResearchFunding.ReviewCompletionTracking.OverdueReviewsEscalated
requirements.text: J6 — An assignment whose due date passes without a submitted review becomes overdue and the reviewer and officer are told.

requirements.name: ::Quorum.ResearchFunding.ReviewCompletionTracking.ThreeReviewsBeforeScoring
requirements.text: INV-5 — A proposal requires exactly three submitted reviews (on non-revoked assignments) before it may enter scored.

requirements.name: ::Quorum.ResearchFunding.ReviewerAssignment.NoConflictedAssignment
requirements.text: INV-3 — A reviewer with a declared conflict against a proposal can never hold an assignment to it.

requirements.name: ::Quorum.ResearchFunding.ReviewerAssignment.NoSelfReview
requirements.text: INV-4 — An applicant can never be assigned to review their own proposal.

requirements.name: ::Quorum.ResearchFunding.ReviewerAssignment.VerifiedReviewersOnly
requirements.text: INV-12 — A reviewer may hold an assignment only if their ORCID identity is verified.

businessRules.name: ::Quorum.ResearchFunding.Adjudication.ChairOnScoredOnly
businessRules.statement: A panel decision is recorded only by an account holding the panel_chair role, only for a proposal with an open adjudication case (which exists only once the proposal is scored), only once, and an award only when no integrity hold is on the case.

businessRules.name: ::Quorum.ResearchFunding.Adjudication.EnvelopeNotExceeded
businessRules.statement: An award commits its amount only by a single conditional write on the call's ledger row that succeeds only if committed + amount <= envelope; otherwise nothing is recorded and the case returns to the chair.

businessRules.name: ::Quorum.ResearchFunding.Notification.NoScoresToReviewers
businessRules.statement: A notification addressed to a reviewer never carries another reviewer's scores or comments.

businessRules.name: ::Quorum.ResearchFunding.PeerReview.AssignmentValidity
businessRules.statement: An assignment is valid only if: the proposal is assignable (confirmed eligible and not withdrawn); the reviewer holds the reviewer role; their ORCID is verified (asked of Identity in the same transaction); no conflict is declared between them and the proposal; they are not the proposal's applicant; they hold no other active assignment to it; and the proposal has fewer than three active assignments.

businessRules.name: ::Quorum.ResearchFunding.PeerReview.EveryCriterionScored
businessRules.statement: A review is submitted only if it carries exactly one score for every criterion published on the call, each an integer from 1 to 5.

businessRules.name: ::Quorum.ResearchFunding.PeerReview.PeerReviewsHiddenUntilOwnSubmitted
businessRules.statement: Another reviewer's scores and comments on a proposal are returned to a reviewer only if that reviewer's own review of the proposal is submitted.

businessRules.name: ::Quorum.ResearchFunding.PeerReview.ThreeSubmittedReviews
businessRules.statement: ProposalFullyReviewed is published once, when the count of submitted reviews on non-revoked assignments of the proposal reaches exactly three.

businessRules.name: ::Quorum.ResearchFunding.Submission.ApplicantScope
businessRules.statement: An applicant reads and changes only proposals whose applicantId is their own account; any other proposal is reported as not found.

businessRules.name: ::Quorum.ResearchFunding.Submission.SubmissionWindowOpen
businessRules.statement: SubmitProposal is accepted only while the proposal's call is open and the current instant is strictly before the call's deadline; checked against the call store inside the submitting transaction.

businessRules.name: ::Quorum.ResearchFunding.Submission.SubmittedOnce
businessRules.statement: SubmitProposal moves draft -> submitted and nothing else; a proposal not in draft is refused with already_submitted. Withdrawal is the only way back out, and it is terminal.

policies.name: ::Quorum.ResearchFunding.BlindReview
policies.statement: No reviewer sees another reviewer's scores or comments, directly, through the portfolio or through a notification, before their own review of that proposal is submitted. Officers and chairs see all submitted reviews.

policies.name: ::Quorum.ResearchFunding.HumansDecide
policies.statement: Eligibility, assignment and award are human decisions. Automation proposes, detects and escalates; it never decides.

policies.name: ::Quorum.ResearchFunding.RoleScopedAccess
policies.statement: Deny by default. Every operation names the roles that may call it and the resources each role is scoped to: applicants their own proposals, reviewers their own assignments, officers and chairs the whole funding programme. Roles are read from the account store on every request.

risks.label: RISK
risks.what: A future service granted writes on ProposalStore silently re-opens multi-writer status
risks.note: recorded with ADR-001 Submission is the single writer of Proposal.status; adjudication starts on ProposalScored (proposed)

risks.label: RISK
risks.what: A future 'adjust envelope' feature would invalidate the reconsider-only-declines reasoning
risks.note: recorded with ADR-006 INV-9 enforced by one conditional write on Adjudication's own budget ledger (proposed)

risks.label: RISK
risks.what: A parked message stops that proposal's progress for that consumer until an officer acts; surfaced on the operations view
risks.note: recorded with ADR-007 Transactional outbox, per-proposal ordering, per-consumer progress, park after five attempts (proposed)

risks.label: RISK
risks.what: INV-10 in ADL rests on the absence of a command-sending tool; a later 'uses' edge would erase it with no diagnostic, so a test verifies the agent itself
risks.note: recorded with ADR-011 Triage is advisory and non-blocking; the agent holds no command-sending tool and no decision autonomy (proposed)

risks.label: RISK
risks.what: A budget release on rescission invalidates ADR-006's 'awards are final, the envelope never grows' premise; reconsider stays decline-only, so a proposal refused for budget is not revisited when budget is released
risks.note: recorded with ADR-017 A declared conflict voids the review in every phase; a voided counted review reopens the round; a decision on it is suspended for integrity review (proposed)

risks.label: RISK
risks.what: Quorum does not model disbursement; the release rests on the Program Officer's attestation (BDL unspecified FundsDisbursement)
risks.note: recorded with ADR-017 A declared conflict voids the review in every phase; a voided counted review reopens the round; a decision on it is suspended for integrity review (proposed)

risks.label: RISK
risks.what: A conflict declared late re-opens a proposal the applicant believed settled; the time window for this is unbounded (owner question)
risks.note: recorded with ADR-017 A declared conflict voids the review in every phase; a voided counted review reopens the round; a decision on it is suspended for integrity review (proposed)

risks.label: RISK
risks.what: A skip drops the event's whole effect, including state later events rely on (a skipped ProposalSubmitted notification means later applicant emails cannot be addressed)
risks.note: recorded with ADR-020 Repeatedly failing deliveries: park, alert, then retry or skip with a reason; never skip an invariant's input (proposed)

risks.label: RISK
risks.what: Mail already delivered and backups taken before the erasure keep the data until they age out; free text that does not contain the exact values is not found
risks.note: recorded with ADR-021 Erasure by pseudonymisation and redaction of the retained event log (proposed)

risks.label: RISK
risks.what: A second instance would need a shared store; behind a proxy, trustProxy must be configured or every client shares one address
risks.note: recorded with ADR-022 Rate limiting in process, on failed sign-ins and per-account request rates (proposed)

risks.label: RISK
risks.what: A notification relies on the shared revocation reason REVOKED_ON_ERASURE to route the message to officers instead of the erased account
risks.note: recorded with ADR-023 Account erasure clears ORCID verification and releases the erased reviewer's outstanding work (proposed)
